AbsolutePathBuf.description:
A path that is guaranteed to be absolute and normalized (though it is not guaranteed to be canonicalized or exist on the filesystem).

IMPORTANT: When deserializing an `AbsolutePathBuf`, a base path must be set using [AbsolutePathBufGuard::new]. If no base path is set, the deserialization will fail unless the path being deserialized is already absolute.

capabilities.description: Rolling-generation behaviors supported by this server.

generation.description: Host lifecycle generation backed by an immutable package.

instanceId.description: Unique identity for this process start.

protocolRevision.description: Reviewed compatibility revision for rolling-generation behavior.

sourceSha.description: Exact source commit recorded by the package builder.

platformOs.description: Operating system for the running app-server target, for example `"macos"`, `"linux"`, or `"windows"`.

serverIdentity.description:
Identity of a host-managed rolling app-server generation.

This is null for ordinary stdio and unmanaged app-server processes.
